item.title: PillPad 0.1.0
item.description:
### Added
- **First release of PillPad.** A native macOS diagramming whiteboard for
  sketching how a business fits together: pills you name after people,
  groups you label as departments, and flows that show who reports to whom.
- **Pills, groups, flows, shapes and text.** Drop a pill and type its name,
  draw a boundary around a cluster and label it, pull a flow from one pill's
  edge to another (or to a whole department) and label the line. Rectangles,
  ellipses, diamonds, lines and free text cover everything that isn't an org
  chart.
- **Everything is undoable.** Moves, resizes, recolours, grouping, deleting —
  ⌘Z steps back through all of it, and your document autosaves as you work.
- **Start from a template.** Choose Blank, Org Structure or Process Flow when
  you create a document; each card shows a live preview of what you'll get.
- **Export for the deck.** Save the canvas as a crisp PNG or a PDF with real
  text, ready to drop into a slide or an email after the meeting.
- **Your files are yours.** A `.pillpad` document is plain JSON you can keep
  in iCloud Drive, Dropbox or a git repo, and open with Open Recent like any
  other Mac document.
- **Auto-updates.** PillPad checks for new versions on its own and installs
  them in one click.
